# Selected comparison adapter fixtures

`helpers.py` reuses the unchanged 358 synthetic original producer records and
actual Store, journal, selected result actions, retained grading and frozen typed
forms. Its target reader is an explicitly supplied test port. No ViennaRNA
import, native scientific process, network call or HPC operation is used.

Comparison actions call the actual D retained worker. The two supplied
structures are `GGGAAACCC / (((...)))` and `GGGAAAUCC / (((...)))`; both have
three preserved pairs and no pairing change under their explicit substitution
correspondence. They do not contain a native energy. Scan ranks are therefore
unavailable; failure, absence and alias counts remain distinguishable. These
tests do not claim a new native run or the complete root Workflow path.
